Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: 9/17/26: a COTA supervisor is only kept for a COTA user, a CF supervisor only for a CF user. The Accounts page used to send the previous account's hidden supervisor along with a non-COTA/CF account.

Value.Calculation: If ( Let ( [ ~list = JSONListValues ( $role ; "" ) ; ~list = If ( Left ( ~list ; 1 ) = "?" ; $role ; ~list ) ] ; not IsEmpty ( FilterValues ( ~list ; "CF" ) ) ) ; JSONGetElement ( $param ; "cfSupervisorId" ) ; "" )

If ( Let ( [ ~list = JSONListValues ( $role ; "" ) ; ~list = If ( Left ( ~list ; 1 ) = "?" ; $role ; ~list ) ] ; not IsEmpty ( FilterValues ( ~list ; "COTA" ) ) ) ; JSONGetElement ( $param ; "cotaSupervisorId" ) ; "" )
